_method: READ-ONLY static analysis of sovereign-engine source + coefficient data

features.name: tense switch count between consecutive sentences
approximate entropy of sentence length sequence (CV)
contrast delta (mean apex - mean banal length)
apex isolation (mean gap between apex sentences)
epistemic marker rate (semblait, perhaps... per sentence *100)
subordination depth (SUB words ratio per sentence, mean)
subordination markers per sentence (alias of f26a_mean_sub_markers, used by CI_L37)
dialogue ratio (lines with dialogue markers / total lines)
features.note: Voice genome feature, not in coefficient table

features.name: coefficient of variation of sentence lengths
features.note: Telemetry feature, used in tension-14d oracle

_notes.semicolon_count: NOT FOUND as standalone feature in codebase. Semicolons are counted inside f33b_commas_count (regex [,;]). Language-profiles.ts references semicolon importance (L31) but no separate feature ID.
_notes.dash_count: NOT FOUND as standalone feature in scoring pipeline.
_notes.excl_count: NOT FOUND as standalone feature. Exclamation marks are counted inside f33a_dots_count (regex [.!?]).
_notes.ellipsis_count: NOT FOUND as standalone count. Ellipsis presence tracked via f18f_ellipsis_final (rate of sentences ending with ...).
_notes.colon_count: NOT FOUND as standalone feature in scoring pipeline.
_notes.std_sent_len: Equivalent to f1a_rhythm_variance (stdev of sentence lengths). Also f19d_sentence_len_std in coefficient table.
_notes.cv_sent: Found in pipeline-telemetry.ts as computed CV = stdev/mean of sentence lengths.
